page_title: MNT 1-1 NAN | Montpellier v Nantes 26/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+9' The free kick from Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) is cleared away from danger by one of the defenders.
90+4' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) is sent off after deserving nothing other than a red card from a referee for clattering into his opponent!
90+3' That's the end of the game for Teji Savanier, who is replaced by Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier).
90+1' Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier) makes an ugly challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' The Nantes players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
88' Kader Bamba (Nantes) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
87' Antoine Kombouare has decided to make a change. Tino Kadewere (Nantes) replaces Florent Mollet.
87' Substitution. Matthis Abline walks off the pitch and Benie Traore (Nantes) comes on as a substitute.
82' A player from Nantes commits a rough challenge. Jeremy Stinat blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.

79' Montpellier are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
78' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jeremy Stinat no option but to blow his whistle.
75' Here is a change. Mostafa Mohamed is going off and Antoine Kombouare gives the last tactical orders to Eray Comert (Nantes).
75' We are about to witness a subsitution. Kader Bamba (Nantes) for Marcus Coco.
74' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for an infringement.
69' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Mousa Al-Tamari as he is replaced by Khalil Fayad (Montpellier).
69' Michel Der Zakarian prepares a substitution. Akor Adams is replaced by Yann Karamoh (Montpellier).
69' Here comes a substitution. Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) is brought on as a substitute for Joris Chotard.
68' Florent Mollet (Nantes) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
65' Montpellier string together a series of short passes.
62' Substitution. Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) has come on for Pedro Chirivella.
60' Florent Mollet (Nantes) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
58' Nantes keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
54' Florent Mollet (Nantes) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
54' Florent Mollet (Nantes) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
53' Montpellier are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.

48' Matthis Abline (Nantes) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
46' Referee Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) was quite harsh and Jeremy Stinat didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+4' Montpellier control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

45+2' Matthis Abline (Nantes) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Benjamin Lecomte makes a great save to stop the effort going into the bottom left corner.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Yellow card. Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
45' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
44' Jeremy Stinat blows for a foul after Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
41' An accurate cross finds its way to Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) who sends in a bullet header towards the bottom right corner from just outside the box, but the goalkeeper makes the save.
41' Nantes are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
38' Florent Mollet (Nantes) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
36' Some patient build-up play from Montpellier as they look to unlock the defence.
34' A corner kick by Montpellier is thwarted by the well prepared Alban Lafont (Nantes). The linesman makes the right call and Montpellier will have a corner.
31' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Montpellier comes to nothing.
30' Florent Mollet (Nantes) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
27' Montpellier are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
24' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
24' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
24' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) commits a rough challenge and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for an infringement.
21' Jeremy Stinat interrupts the game. One of the players from Montpellier won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
20' Montpellier are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

17' Akor Adams (Montpellier) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.

16' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
13' Marcus Coco (Nantes) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
10' Poor challenge! Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) is penalised for tripping and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle.
7' 1 - 1 Matthis Abline (Nantes) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom right corner. Magnificent finish!
6' Montpellier hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.

5' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
2' 1 - 0 Akor Adams (Montpellier) receives a well-taken defence-splitting pass inside the box and scores! He buries the ball into the bottom left corner.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Nantes will take the kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat will officiate today.
